findings.title: Bengaluru opening ads use a comment-to-DM code mechanic
findings.evidence: ID 2190804264833947 names Sai Meadows, Kudlu; ID 2327094064759580 names J R Plaza, Kanakpura Road. Both were Active on 04 Oct, started 24 Sep, ask viewers to comment ‘Popeyes Chicken’ for a DM code, and state a ₹199 minimum order and ‘until stocks last.’
findings.analysis: The public action path has several stages—comment, DM code, order and redemption. The card does not show whether each stage is reconciled in the brand's own reporting.
findings.next_check: With account and store access, compare comment/DM code issuance with eligible order redemption; first confirm whether the advertised offer remains available.

findings.title: The ad's own terms make current offer availability unconfirmed
findings.evidence: The cards say the offer is valid until stocks last and reserve the right to change terms; the creative advertises opening from 1 Oct.
findings.analysis: This report records the published ad copy and does not state that the free item is currently redeemable.
findings.next_check: Check current offer terms and branch availability before reusing the creative or code.

findings.title: The official email is customer care, not an established campaign owner
